title: Qwen3.6-35B Claude 4.6 Opus Reasoning Distilled
summary: A 35B Mixture-of-Experts LLM based on the Qwen3.6 architecture, fine-tuned using reasoning traces distilled from Claude 4.6 Opus. It is optimized for agentic coding and complex problem-solving while maintaining high inference speeds on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Native context window of 262,144 tokens; compatible with latest llama.cpp. Avoid using with CUDA 13.2 due to reported output corruption.

evolution.summary: This model succeeded earlier Qwen3.5-based distillation experiments, leveraging the newer MoE architecture and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for improved efficiency. It remains a top choice for local reasoning tasks as of mid-2026.
